description: A team of curious minds with big dreams!
summary: Our project explores the Sun, the centre of our solar system and the most important source of energy for life on Earth. It explains how the Sun produces energy, its structure, solar activities and their effects on our planet.
details: Our project, The Sun, explores the Sun's structure, energy production and activities such as solar flares and sunspots. It highlights the Sun's importance as the main source of energy that supports life on Earth. This project aims to increase scientific knowledge and encourage students to explore astronomy and space science.
